Griha Pravesh Puja

₹4,200 onwards3–5 hrs

Griha Pravesh Puja marks the auspicious entry into a new home, invoking blessings for peace, prosperity, and protection for everyone who will live there. Our priests conduct the complete vidhi including Vastu Shanti, Navagraha pooja, and the sacred fire ceremony to purify the space before you move in.
